title: 多変量データの統計科学の基礎
subtitle: Fundamentals of Statistical Science for Multivariate Data
keywords: Multivariate analysis 2.Prediction model 3.Multiple regression analysis 4.Principal component analysis
educationalGoal: In evaluation problems related to humanities and social sciences, many properties must be often handled simultaneously and comprehensively, and multivariate analysis methods can often provide effective solutions. In this course, students will learn the concepts of and ways of using multivariate analysis via Excel functions. The primary goal is to give them the opportunity to master the method of prediction analysis and learn how to summarize multivariate data. Another goal is to ensure they are capable of using these methods in future learning activities.
advice: The course focuses on the following items: 1. Features and summary of multivariate analysis (prediction and data summarization) 2. The concept and use method of multiple regression analysis 3. The concept and use method of principal component analysis 4. How to use Excel functions Students are expected to review the basic knowledge of linear algebra. In addition, they should learn the contents of descriptive statistics in “Statistics for Information”. It is also desirable to understand the contents of hypothesis testing.
requiredKnowledge: Review linear algebra (i.e., matrices and vectors). Students must be sure to master the lecture contents by reviewing because each item is closely related to previous lessons. Bring a laptop PC (unless otherwise noted) because the lessons will always include practice sessions using Excel.

activityGoals.body: Be able to use multivariate analysis in future learning activities such as Project Design III.
Be able to distinguish the prediction model concept from the data summarization concept.
Be able to understand the basic concepts and application methods of multiple regression analysis.
Be able to understand the basic concepts and application methods of principal component analysis.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to grasp the importance of multivariate analysis in the analysis of evaluation problems. Be able to understand the theory of each method, use statistical procedures properly, and derive suitable knowledge from analysis results.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to grasp the importance of multivariate analysis in the analysis for evaluation problems. Be able to understand the basic concepts of each method, use statistical procedures, and interpret analysis results by referring to the textbook.
